svg.title: RNA strand
svg.desc: Original OpenSketch flat schematic. Independent vector parts; use the Scientific structures palette for path editing.

path.style: stroke: rgb(37,73,75); stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dashoffset: 0; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-miterlimit: 4; fill: none; fill-rule: nonzero; opacity: 1;
